We are delighted to announce the official publication of Berkley First School’s recent Ofsted inspection report. We are incredibly proud of this achievement, which reflects the hard work and dedication of our pupils, staff, and wider school community.
Read the full report here to see what makes Berkley First School so special.
Every day is an open day at Berkley School.
Come and have a look around the school.
Call or email the office to make an appointment.
Welcome Message from the Head
CURRICULUM Curriculum
NEW STARTERS New Starters

Introduction to British Values at Berkley School
At Berkley School, British Values are not taught as standalone concepts but are woven naturally into everything we do. Through our nurturing ethos, rich curriculum, and strong sense of community, children learn about democracy, the rule of law, individual liberty, mutual respect and tolerance in meaningful, age‑appropriate ways. These values shape our expectations, guide our relationships, and help our pupils grow into confident, respectful and responsible young citizens. Our British Values statement explains how these principles are embedded across school life and how we support every child to understand their role in modern Britain.
British Values statement 2026
Our wonderful Parents of FBS organised a fantastic Movie Night for the children. In true Berkley style, they linked the event to the British Value of democracy by giving every child the chance to vote for the film they most wanted to watch.
The children loved having their say, and the winning movie was chosen fairly based on their votes. It was a great example of how we help pupils understand democracy in a fun, meaningful way—showing that everyone’s voice matters.

Our Vision and Values
“We are a small school with big ideas – taking a creative approach to help every child flourish, thrive, and reach their full potential.”
At Berkley First School, our vision and ethos are inspired by the words of Jesus in the Sermon on the Mount (Matthew 5:14–16): “You are the light that gives light to the world… Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good works.”
We believe every child is a unique individual – full of potential, guided by faith, and part of a supportive and caring community.
As a Church of England Voluntary Aided School, our values are deeply rooted in Christian teachings. We follow the Church of England’s Vision for Education – “Deeply Christian, serving the common good” – and work closely with our local church, St Mary’s in Berkley.
Our Core Values
We aim to develop children who are:
Kind and respectful towards others
Resilient and confident in facing challenges
Curious and creative in their learning
Responsible and thoughtful members of the school and wider community
These values are woven through our daily life – from the way we learn and play, to how we support one another and celebrate achievements. Whether it's through acts of kindness, teamwork in the classroom, or quiet moments of reflection, our children are encouraged to “let their light shine” in all that they do.

Life As a Church School
At Berkley First School, our Christian vision – “Let Your Light Shine” – is at the heart of everything we do.
We are a small school, with big ideas, adopting a creative approach to ensure that every child is supported in order to flourish and thrive; to see and develop their true potential
As a proud Church of England school, we nurture each child’s unique potential within a caring, inclusive, and spiritually rich environment. Our values of compassion, respect, perseverance and hope guide our daily lives, encouraging children to flourish not only academically but personally and morally too. In our most recent SIAMS inspector(2024), we were delighted to be recognised for
the strong sense of community, the way our Christian vision shapes school life, and the meaningful opportunities we provide for children to reflect, ask big questions, and grow in character and faith.
We aim to inspire our pupils to make a positive difference in the world -starting with kindness, understanding, and service to others.
Nativity in St Mary's Church
Assembly with the Bishop
RE Curriculum Overview
Our worship timetable helps guide our daily and weekly collective worship. Each session is carefully planned to reflect our school values, celebrate togetherness, and provide time for reflection and spiritual growth.
Berkley Worship Timetable
Class Worship led by the Senior Teacher or Headteacher reflecting on our focus Christian Value
Singing assembly led by the Senior Teacher learning songs and hymns for the term
Class assemblies with the class teacher linked to our focus Christian Value
Whole school worship in Church led by members of the church community and Senior Teacher.
Certificate assembly led by the Senior Teacher. Children are awarded certificates for WOW moments in their learning, reading skills and actions linked to our focus Christian Value..

Welcome
On behalf of the children, staff and governors, it is with great pleasure that I welcome you to our school website.
Our school community lives out our vision of ‘Let your light shine’ every day and fosters a nurturing ethos based around core values. We take immense pride in our achievements, developments, and improvements, both academically and emotionally.
We are wholeheartedly committed to working with you to provide the very best care, nurture, and learning experiences for your child, enabling them to achieve their full potential during their time with us. We believe that children should be happy at school and have ample opportunities to develop as individuals. While it is important for children to be proficient in reading, writing, and mathematics, it is equally crucial for them to manage their own learning, communicate effectively, and make informed choices about their behaviour. Our aim is to ensure that the children leave us ready to make a positive impact on the world.
If you haven’t had the chance to visit our school yet, you really must! Our school family is made up of children from the town of Frome and also further afield, giving us a wide-reaching community. We hope to see you soon.
